what_it_is: Inorbit Space Telecommunications Private Limited is a New Delhi company authorised to provide foreign satellite capacity over India - public IN-SPACE authorisation listings show it enabling provisioning of AsiaSat's AS-7 satellite capacity over India, with authorisation running into 2026.
india_angle: Inorbit sits in the sensitive satcom-authorisation layer of Indian space policy: public IN-SPACe records and 2025 reporting on the withdrawal of AsiaSat authorisations make it a concrete example of how India regulates foreign-capacity resellers.
intelligence_assessment: The IN-SPACe authorisation registry gives this entity unusually official evidence. Its commercial scale is not public; watch authorisation renewals and satcom policy reforms as the key events.

faq.a: It is authorised to provision foreign satellite (AsiaSat AS-7) capacity over India under IN-SPACe authorisation.

open_questions: Confirm whether any Indian service, agency or company operates this entity.
Attach at least three independent, verifiable public sources (preferably MoD/PIB/OEM documents) to lift this entity to Tier B.
